recurrence_certificate: over each survivor residue field the normalized pure sequence satisfies nu_(m+1)=0 with initial value nu_1=0

boundary_conclusion: every coordinate boundary has support at most eight and is SIC-safe by the complete support-eight theorem
global_conclusion: all 816 full-incidence (3,2,2,2)^2 coordinate subspaces are SIC-safe
